title: Backup tools: retention, compression and automatic verification

videos.script: A base backup, an archive command and a cron job make a backup. They also leave out the hard parts. {{parts}} What to delete, and when. How to copy only what changed. How to prove that the copy is still the copy. {{list}} In this lesson a tool does all of that: pgBackRest. You install it, point it at the server, and take a full backup. {{full}} Then a differential and an incremental, and you read what each one depends on. {{chain}} You watch retention delete an old backup, together with the log only it needed. {{expire}} Then you damage one file in the repository, and ask the tool to verify it. It finds the damage. It also exits with success. {{verify}} That is the most useful thing in this lesson. You end with a nightly job that reads the report, and refuses to call silence a pass. {{job}}
